profiles.label: Website, landing page, or frontend build
profiles.description: A persuasive or operational web surface that needs verified brand truth, implementation, responsive QA, and a mapped release path.
artifact_manifest: Verified client route, site, repository, and release target
Product truth, approved copy, brand assets, and visual authority
Surface brief with mode, job, proof sequence, and acceptance criteria
Desktop and mobile implementation with responsive states
Accessibility, interaction, console, link, form, and overflow QA receipt
Reviewable preview or the exact mapped live URL when standing approval applies
prepare_now: Resolve the exact client, repository, current site, and deployment mapping
Collect the approved logo, imagery, copy, tokens, and reference surface
Write the smallest implementation and QA contract before building
human_gates: New public site, ambiguous deployment target, client sign-off, credentials, or non-Netlify publication

inputs: Exact client route from client-operations registry/clients.json and the current live URL
Approved logo, photography, palette source, and copy facts (address, phone, hours, offerings) with source locators
Deployment mapping: Netlify site or client folder, noindex state, and custom-domain owner

assets: Logo as SVG or PNG; hero and proof photos converted to webp with honest alt text
data: Verified business facts only; an empty field beats an invented one
repository: Clean branch in dillon-os or the client repo; output under philly-sites/<slug> or 01_Clients/<Client>/website

output_formats: One self-contained index.html inside the 27 to 37 KB budget plus assets/
Reviewable Netlify preview URL, or the exact mapped live URL when standing approval applies
qa: qa-critic pass: contrast, keyboard focus, links, forms, console errors, mobile overflow
LocalBusiness JSON-LD and the noindex flag match the deployment intent
AEO and trust gate before any live publication
gates: New public site, custom-domain change, client sign-off, credential entry, or publication outside standing Netlify approval

profiles.label: Branded client report or performance presentation
profiles.description: A source-backed weekly, monthly, or milestone report that reconciles platform delivery with real outcomes and ships in a client-specific visual system.
artifact_manifest: Exact reporting period, client route, and source-of-truth ledger
Platform, CRM, booking, or lead evidence with freshness and attribution labels
Client-specific branded source document or design template
Rendered PDF or presentation with whole-number lead and conversion-event counts where required
QA checklist covering KPI math, brand separation, claims, dates, and page rendering
Delivery manifest or draft message; sending remains separately governed
prepare_now: Freeze the reporting window and identify every required source
Reconcile platform events to CRM or booking outcomes before writing conclusions
Load the exact prior approved template and client visual assets
human_gates: Unverified conversion definitions, inaccessible source fields, external delivery, or a client/account mismatch

inputs: Client route, exact reporting period, and the source-of-truth ledger (platform exports, CRM, booking, call logs) with freshness dates
The prior approved report for the same client as the structural and visual baseline
Conversion definitions confirmed per client; anything unverified is marked pending validation
templates: _os/reporting/data/bar-crawl-usa-2026-06.json for the data shape and _os/reporting/build-report.js as the renderer

assets: Client logo and palette tokens taken from the client folder, never redrawn
data: Whole-integer lead and event counts; sampleData stays true until every figure is real
repository: Output under Daily-Briefs/reports or the client-operations deliverables folder for that period

output_formats: Rendered PDF with page-render QA screenshots
qa: KPI math recomputed from the ledger
Brand separation: one client per document, no cross-client numbers
Dates, periods, and claims match sources; never a zero-conversion claim without a validated definition
gates: External delivery, inaccessible source fields, unverified conversion definitions, or a client/account mismatch

profiles.label: BOK weekly three-topic designed content kit
profiles.description: The standing BOK Law Firm weekly package: source-bound legal copy, three expected generated visual backgrounds, and three branded template graphics, with the packet remaining authoritative if its count differs.
artifact_manifest: The exact weekly PDF packet or current attorney-approved source, treated as sole content truth
Three expected topic and copy records; stop and surface a mismatch if the source requests another count
Three topic-specific background images generated with ChatGPT image generation, one per topic, with no fabricated legal claims or text baked into the art
Three branded template graphics in the required PNG and JPG formats
Source and final PDFs plus a contact sheet or rendered-page inspection set
Copy, geography, names, dates, distinctions, image count, and Facebook-page duplicate-check receipt
prepare_now: Locate and fingerprint the newest source packet before drafting or generating images
Resolve the three topics, exact copy, dates, and approved BOK template
Prepare three ChatGPT image-generation prompts and output slots without publishing anything
human_gates: Missing or conflicting packet, legal/geographic ambiguity, wrong Facebook page, duplicate schedule, or any content outside the exact approved source

inputs: Newest attorney-approved weekly packet PDF, for example clients/bok-law-firm/deliverables/<date>-*/pdf/BOK_Corrected_Weekly_Social_Content.pdf, fingerprinted before any drafting
Three topic and copy records in drafts/01-*.md, 02-*.md, and 03-*.md derived only from that packet
The approved BOK designed template and brand tokens from the client folder
templates: clients/bok-law-firm/deliverables/2026-09-01-three-blogs/build_social_packet.py and build_pdfs.py as the current generators
qa/pdf-verification.json and qa/social-final from the prior week as the acceptance reference

assets: Three ChatGPT-generated topic backgrounds, one per topic, with no legal text baked into the art
BOK logo and template layers available offline
data: Exact topic titles, attorney names and distinctions, dates, and western Pennsylvania service-area language from the packet
repository: A new dated deliverable folder in client-operations for the week; a prior week is never overwritten

output_formats: Three branded graphics as PNG and JPG at the template's native size
Source and final PDFs plus a contact sheet or rendered-page inspection set
qa: Copy matches the packet verbatim; no invented legal claims
Geography reads as western Pennsylvania, not Pittsburgh-only
Image count equals topic count (expected three); a mismatch stops the run
Facebook page identity and duplicate-schedule check recorded
gates: Missing or conflicting packet, legal or geographic ambiguity, wrong Facebook page, duplicate schedule, or any content outside the approved source

profiles.label: Prototype, wireframe, or concept system
profiles.description: A reviewable product or experience concept that makes decisions visible before implementation scope is locked.
artifact_manifest: Problem, audience, decision, and non-goals
Verified product and brand constraints
Primary flow, key states, and realistic content
Interactive or rendered prototype at the requested fidelity
Decision log, assumptions, open questions, and implementation handoff
Usability, accessibility, and responsive review notes appropriate to fidelity
prepare_now: Identify the decision the prototype must unlock
Collect only the context needed for the primary flow
Choose fidelity and acceptance criteria before producing screens
human_gates: Client sign-off, production implementation, public sharing, or scope changes inferred from a visual alone

inputs: The one decision the prototype must unlock, its audience, and its non-goals
Verified product and brand constraints from the client folder
Realistic content for the primary flow, not placeholder text
templates: philly-sites/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md tokens when the prototype is for a Momentum-built surface
.claude/skills ui-design and ux-audit; the anti-ui-slop finish gate when available

assets: Logo, palette, and any existing screens as reference
data: Primary flow states covered: empty, loading, error, success
repository: Prototype folder under the client deliverables or 01_Clients/<Client>/prototype

output_formats: Static HTML prototype or rendered PNG boards at the agreed fidelity
Decision log with assumptions and open questions
qa: Every screen names the decision it serves
Contrast, focus, and responsive checks appropriate to the fidelity
No implementation scope inferred from a visual alone
gates: Client sign-off, production build, public sharing, or scope change inferred from the prototype

profiles.label: Data source, tracking, or API integration
profiles.description: A governed connection that maps identifiers, fields, freshness, privacy, and verification from source to consumer.
artifact_manifest: Exact client, account, environment, source owner, and destination consumer
Identifier and field map with privacy, consent, and retention boundaries
Authentication and secret locator contract with no secret values in artifacts
Read-only or sandbox connection test and representative sample receipt
Freshness, deduplication, reconciliation, retry, and failure-state rules
Production activation and rollback checklist, kept behind the required account and approval gates
prepare_now: Resolve the exact source account and destination before configuring anything
Draft the field and identifier map, including missing decisions
Prepare a synthetic or read-only acceptance test
human_gates: MFA, CAPTCHA, new consent, credentials, billing, production writes, or account changes

inputs: Exact client, source account, environment, source owner, and destination consumer
Identifier and field map with privacy, consent, and retention boundaries
Secret locators only (Windows Credential Manager entry or Netlify variable names); never secret values
templates: account-binding.template.json and acceptance-cases.json from that same package

data: A read-only or synthetic sample payload per event type
repository: Receiver or connector code with node --test coverage and a dry-run drain path

output_formats: Contract markdown, field-map JSON, and acceptance-cases JSON
Verification receipt with sample identifiers redacted
qa: Acceptance cases pass against the receiver
Idempotency and version handling verified with a replayed payload
No secret value appears in any artifact
gates: MFA, CAPTCHA, new consent, credential entry, billing, production writes, or account changes

profiles.label: Repository, environment, connector, or deployment configuration
profiles.description: A bounded engineering setup that establishes source control, runtime, connectors, deployment mapping, and verification without blending projects or secrets.
artifact_manifest: Canonical project and client route plus current repository inventory
Branch, worktree, runtime, and environment contract
Non-secret account and access mapping
Configuration changes with reversible defaults and no embedded secrets
Build, test, connector, and deployment verification receipts
Handoff describing what is live, staged, blocked, or still approval-gated
prepare_now: Inspect current repository, branch, dirty state, and authenticated account
Resolve exact environment and connector ownership
Create a clean reversible implementation and verification path
human_gates: New repository visibility, account permissions, production deployment outside standing approval, billing, or secret entry

inputs: Canonical project and client route plus the current repository inventory (gh repo list)
Target branch policy, worktree location, runtime versions, and connector ownership
templates: Clean worktree pattern: git worktree add <path> -b <branch> origin/main

data: Required environment variable names and their secret locators
repository: A clean worktree from origin/main; never edit inside a dirty checkout

output_formats: Verification receipt: node --test, Test-SecondBrain, connector health
qa: Secret scan shows no embedded secrets
Tests green before and after the change
Handoff states what is live, staged, blocked, or approval-gated
gates: New repository visibility, permission changes, production deployment outside standing approval, billing, or secret entry
